Synthetic UINT8/16 grayscale+alpha TIFF corpus independently generated by
NumPy/tifffile 2025.6.11 with `generate_tiff_gray_integer_alpha.py`.
Every input SHA-256 is pinned. No external image content.

256 combinations cover two depths, absent/linear/gamma1.8/working GRAY ICC,
associated/unassociated alpha, contiguous/separate planes, classic/BigTIFF,
both byte orders, raw/Deflate and three orientations. Associated raw samples
include fractional/HDR ratios; zero-alpha associated color is zero. Hidden
straight-alpha gray remains in the float32 layer, separate from the composite.
Profiles reuse the established synthetic/working gray corpus. Black-zero gray
is used; white-zero alpha remains a separate unsupported input case.
